content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe, Gumroad, and PayPal are severely restricted, digital creators struggle to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-trap-most-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-only-real-2|payment]] for their ebooks, courses, and digital products. Without access to conventional payment platforms, they're forced to rely on manual workarounds, sacrificing their time and revenue. Here, we'll show you how to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-internationally-until|Do Not]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, leveraging the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to bypass payment platform restrictions, providing digital creators with a sovereign digital commerce stack. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can maintain full data ownership and control over their payment processing. This stack is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that empowers creators to collect payments directly from their customers, without relying on restricted platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you'll need to sign up for a GitHub account (for the Sovereign Starter Stack) or a Cloudflare account (for the Edge Commerce Stack). You'll also need to create a NOWPayments account, which provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. Additionally, you'll require a digital product to sell, such as an ebook or course. Finally, you'll need to configure your store's domain and set up your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments, and connect it to your Cloudflare Pages store. You'll also need to set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store customer orders, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket to deliver digital products. This pipeline will enable you to process payments, store customer data, and deliver digital products directly to your customers.
By deploying a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you can bypass payment platform restrictions and maintain full data ownership and control over your payment processing.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you can go live with your crypto store. To process your first transaction, simply upload your digital product to your Cloudflare Pages store, configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments, and test your pipeline on the mainnet. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), you can deploy your stack in 4-6 hours, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is live and processing transactions, you can scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand. This may involve upgrading your NOWPayments account to support more transactions, configuring your Cloudflare Pages store to handle increased traffic, and optimizing your payment and delivery pipeline to reduce latency and improve customer experience. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), you can handle up to 3 products, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) supports up to 5 products, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured and end-to-end tested.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy a turnkey solution with end-to-end testing, ideal for creators who want a hassle-free experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators who prefer a more DIY approach, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a great option. Alternatively, you can explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a turnkey solution with end-to-end testing. Either way, you can host your digital product store on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, and process payments using NOWPayments. Check out COREMERCH's product offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, follow these steps: Create a GitHub account or Cloudflare account, depending on your chosen stack. Set up a NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. Configure your store's domain and payment and delivery pipeline. Deploy your stack using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Test your pipeline on the mainnet. Go live with your crypto store and start processing transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I deploy my crypto store using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97)?

To deploy your crypto store using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), follow these steps: Create a GitHub account, set up a NOWPayments account, configure your store's domain, and deploy your stack using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) documentation. This process typically takes 4-6 hours.
Can I host my digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host your digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, depending on your chosen stack. Simply create a new repository or account, set up your store's domain, and deploy your stack using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) documentation.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a DIY solution that provides a basic infrastructure for deploying a crypto store, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a turnkey solution that includes end-to-end testing and configuration. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal for creators who want a hassle-free deployment experience, while the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a more affordable option for those who prefer to DIY.
How do I process payments using NOWPayments?

To process payments using NOWPayments, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, configure your store's payment and delivery pipeline, and connect your NOWPayments account to your Cloudflare Pages store. This will enable you to process payments directly from your customers, without relying on restricted platforms.
Can I scale my infrastructure if needed?

Yes, you can scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand. This may involve upgrading your NOWPayments account, configuring your Cloudflare Pages store, and optimizing your payment and delivery pipeline to reduce latency and improve customer experience.
The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) offers a DIY solution that provides a basic infrastructure for deploying a crypto store, at an affordable price.
